references.text: The Lord says to Moses that he has seen this people, and that it is a stiff-necked people - almost identical wording with Deuteronomy 9:13
The Lord refuses to go with the people because they are a stiff-necked people, the same description of Israel's disobedience
The Lord calls Israel a stiff-necked people and warns of the consequences
Moses asks for forgiveness for the people's stubbornness, the same characteristic of the people
Earlier in the same chapter, Moses describes Israel as a stiff-necked people
Moses knows the people's obstinacy and stubbornness, the same theme about the people's disobedient nature
The fathers made their necks stiff and refused to listen, the same image of disobedience toward God
Stephen calls his listeners stiff-necked with uncircumcised hearts and ears, a direct reference to this Old Testament characterization of Israel
